verdict.line: You lose if you stand and trade autos inside 800 units before level 6; you win once you have boots, mana, and Cannon-stance range to kite him from outside Corrosive Charge.

brief.thesis: Urgot's Q (Corrosive Charge) reaches 800 units and his passive (Echoing Flames) punishes every auto-attack exchange, which outranges and out-trades Jayce's 600-range Hammer kit before level 6. The data backs this up directly: Jayce sits at 45.1% over 1215 games here versus his 47.7% baseline, with OP.GG marking Urgot favoured for both the lane and the solo kill.

theirWindow.when: Levels 1-5, Q and Purge both up
theirWindow.what: He wants to land Corrosive Charge then walk Purge stacks onto you while Echoing Flames ticks. If you're caught at auto range with his Q down, back off rather than trading — his passive burns through your HP faster than your Hammer Q threat does.

yourWindow.what: Use R to flip into Cannon stance, deploy the E (Acceleration Gate) and fire a boosted Shock Blast through it, or leap in with Hammer Q, E (Thundering Blow) him off, and swap back out before Purge resets.

powerCurve.note: Q outranges your Hammer kit entirely
R and boots give you kiting tools
His R execute threat matches your range

start.why: 92.7% pick rate at 45.5% WR over 1291 games — the extra HP and sustain are what let you absorb one Corrosive Charge hit without losing the wave.

boots.why: 46.7% WR over 540 games, 42.4% pick — the flat physical damage reduction directly blunts Echoing Flames procs and his Purge unload.

core.why: Starts the Muramana scaling early so your trades hit harder once you can actually land them.
The active haste lets you close distance or disengage faster than Disdain can threaten you — 55.6% WR over 133 games with this path.
Converts your mana pool into the raw damage you need to win trades once you're kiting from range instead of face-tanking Purge.
Adds the burst and slow that punishes him for walking into Shock Blast range.

situational.when: he or his team is stacking shields to blunt your Cannon-stance burst
you need the extra slow to keep him out of Disdain range while kiting

runes.keystoneWhy: OP.GG's own tip for this matchup is to maintain your Conqueror stacks when engaging — the adaptive force and healing let you win the extended trades Urgot's passive otherwise swings his way.

summoners.why: 53% pick rate at 42.6% WR — Teleport lets you reset after the losing early trades this lane produces and still show up for sidelane splits once your items spike.

playing.title: Never auto-trade at level 1
playing.detail: OP.GG flags his level 1 passive specifically — Echoing Flames plus his early Purge rank means a standing trade favours him before you have Q range control.

playing.title: Respect the 800-range Q
playing.detail: Corrosive Charge outranges your Hammer stance by 200 units; stay outside it until you have E (Acceleration Gate) and Cannon-stance Shock Blast to answer at range.

playing.title: Count Disdain's cooldown
playing.detail: E (Disdain) is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s — if he catches you with it he stops and hurls you out of position, so don't stand in a straight line at 475 range once he hits level 2.

playing.title: Punish Purge's wind-down
playing.detail: Purge slows him while he fires, dropping to 0s cooldown at rank 5 — once he's maxed it, engage immediately after he fires it rather than during, since he can't kite while channeling.

playing.title: Use R to disengage, not just engage
playing.detail: Swapping Hammer to Cannon stance via R gives you the range to kite out after a Thundering Blow knockback instead of getting re-caught by his next Q.

playing.title: Push waves, don't duel
playing.detail: With lane and solo-kill both favouring him, prioritize shoving minions under tower and freezing resources for your mid-game item spike rather than looking for even trades.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured from current-patch games via OP.GG; the ability mechanics, timing windows, and tactical reasoning are my own read of the matchup.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid Urgot’s level 1 (P). Keep his (E) in mind when fighting. Maintain your Conqueror stacks when engaging combat.
